job.job_description:
Your Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Agentic AI Developer to design, build, and deploy intelligent autonomous systems using Azure AI Foundry. The role involves developing AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and executing workflows using LLMs and enterprise data
- Design agentic architectures
- Build AI agents with planning and tool use
- Develop multi-agent systems
- Implement RAG pipelines






Your Profile


- Integrate APIs and enterprise systems
- Monitor performance and ensure responsible AI
- Knowledge on Python / C# / JavaScript,Vector databases, API and microservices
-Knowledge on Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI andPrompt engineering and RAG






What you will love about working here


We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
